title: three hv rulings are unexecuted and fileindex ships the option hv declined -- a fold that keyed on dated instead of done
body:
**THREE hv RULINGS ARE UNEXECUTED AND ONE OF THEM SHIPS THE OPTION hv EXPLICITLY DECLINED.** Filed as a numbered item on dc's argument that the sweep's result changes what "3.0.0 is ready" means, so it must be something hv can see rather than a finding in a message.

**THE CAUSE IS A FOLD DEFECT AND IT IS vc's.** hv's rule is *"cut ANY mention of done work out of the wip.md and restart.md docs. They should ONLY EVER contain doing and todo work, no exceptions."* The 2026-08-30 globalfold applied it to `hv/wip.md` by moving the whole dated ruling record into `.history/`. **hv's rule keys on DONE; the fold keyed on DATED.** A ruling nobody has executed is TODO WORK by that rule -- so the fold enforcing "doing and todo only" is what removed todo items. Nothing was deleted, which is exactly the failure: **a live directive reachable only by grepping `.history/` is discoverable by nobody, because grepping `.history/` is not a thing a node does at pickup.**

**THE THREE.**

1. **A4 `fileindex` -- hv ruled RETIRE IT on 2026-08-26 00:19Z.** Menu: RETIRE chosen; BUILD IT declined as uncosted; SHIP UNBUILT AND DECLARED declined. **What ships is the declined option.** `surface/dispatch-table.json` still reads `disposition: keep` with `replacement` absent; `fileindex` is in `--help`, refuses at rc=2 with the UNWIRED marker (*not implemented yet*), and is ABSENT from `intent surface retired` -- where `treeindex`, retired by the same mechanism, is listed and refuses by name. **The two refusals say different things and only one is true: *not implemented yet* means LATER and hv ruled NEVER.** That is `AC-00.5`'s own subject firing on the verb its ruling was quoted at. Measured by dc. Owner cc, `owner_wp: WP-06`.
2. **A6 ic's `## Holds` -- hv ruled LAND IT on 2026-08-26**, with the CONDITION as the required field (dc's sharpening: the condition is load-bearing, not the lifter), taken knowingly as a shipped-skill change with fleet blast radius. **UNEXECUTED.** `intent/plugins/claude/skills/in-whiteboard/SKILL.md` has no such section; its only occurrence of the word is ordinary prose about inboxes at `:119`. **This is the more alarming of the two (dc): `fileindex` has a live binary disagreeing with the ruling so a driver hits it, while a missing skill section is refused by no verb, redded by no gate and counted by no census. It was reachable only by reading the pass against the tree.**
3. **ISSUE WRITE PATH -- hv ruled BUILD THE PACKAGE, 2026-08-28/29.** Menu: package chosen; edit-verb-only declined; leave-as-is declined. Named: `issues edit` (`--body`/`--from`), `issues close --note`, scoped issue sync, then restore the 20 empty bodies from commit archaeology, with `0122` and `0118` as the edit verb's first two drives -- the live cases as the acceptance cases. S-M, hv's own words placing it in cc's lane after Laksa and `0121`. **NONE OF IT IS BUILT.** `intent issues` ships `list add show close open`; there is no `edit`; `close` takes no `--note`.

**AND ITEM 3 MEASURES WHAT THE FOLD COST, IN THE BURYING NODE'S OWN WORK.** On 2026-08-30 vc filed issue `0179` -- *there is no verb that can correct an issue body ... an issue body is write-once ... post-tag, and cheap: either an `issues edit` verb, or `intent edit` accepting the kinds its own address grammar already parses* -- **as a fresh discovery, with a proposed remedy and a cost, four days after hv had ruled that exact package built.** vc could not see the ruling because vc's own fold had moved it. **A buried ruling does not merely go unexecuted; it gets independently rediscovered and re-costed by the node that buried it.**

**THE STRUCTURAL FIX IS LANDED** (`5bdd44ce`, `33b1127f`, `ffeee5ff`): `hv/wip.md` carries a `## Rulings made and NOT yet executed` section, and **an entry leaves it by BEING EXECUTED, never by ageing.** The rule that replaces the one the fold used: **an unexecuted ruling is live state, not history; a fold archives the NARRATIVE of a ruling and never the ruling itself while it is unexecuted.**

**THE SWEEP'S OWN REACH, because a sweep reporting THREE without saying what it drove is `AC-00.16`'s class committed by the audit that found it.** DRIVEN: every archived ruling naming a verb, flag, field, file or table row checkable against the build -- 8 from the 2026-08-26 pass, 9 spot-checked across 2026-08-28/29. CONFIRMED EXECUTED, so it discriminates rather than only accusing: `A12` DIRT_SCOPE derived and parsed by the guard, `A8` withdrawn, `ac new` refusing a taken id, `ac edit` shipped, `ac reinstate` present, `fc` present, `AcState::Unsatisfied { note }` carrying a distinctly-named field, `in-next` retired, `st repair` retired, `surface retired` shipped. **NOT DRIVEN, and nothing here clears them:** every ruling whose subject is prose, sequencing, scope or judgement -- most of the 2026-08-27 six-ruling pass and everything before it -- plus every Conflab and Laksa ruling, whose subjects are not in this tree. **Those need a read, not a grep. The read is vc's and is not done.**
